name: Shrine of Aessina
summary: At the Shrine of Aessina, night elves honor an ancient spirit of nature and wild creatures. The shrine lies in southwestern Ashenvale, between Maestra's Post and Astranaar, where border friction is growing.

sections.title: A Sanctuary of the Deep Woods
sections.body: West of Astranaar, night elves honor Aessina, a Wild God who bears the heart and spirit of the deep forests. For generations, they and their woodland kin have come here to commune with nature, far from the main roads. The Horde presses into Ashenvale for timber and footholds, and peace grows uncertain at sacred grounds across the territory.

faq.answer: Aessina is an ancient nature spirit and Wild God tied to the heart of pristine forests. Night elves and woodland beings honor her as nature's living soul and the untamed wilderness.

faq.q: Where is the Shrine of Aessina located?
faq.answer: The shrine lies in southwestern Ashenvale, southwest of Maestra's Post and west of Astranaar.

faq.q: Why is this place significant to the night elves?
faq.answer: Night elves honor the shrine as an ancient holy retreat for woodland spirits. It joins their society and druidic traditions to Kalimdor's untamed wilderness.

angles.text: As a druid who protects Kalimdor's natural balance, you honor the living spirit of the wild woods at this ancient shrine.
For the Kaldorei, the shrine recalls centuries of harmony with Ashenvale's native spirits, now threatened by encroaching outside forces.
